ebmt-score.l: Disease stage [early = 0; intermediate = 1; late = 2]. Severe aplastic anemia is always early.
Transplanted in first complete remission. YES SUPPRESSES THE TIMING ITEM ENTIRELY: it scores 0 regardless of the interval, and the maximum reachable score becomes 6.
Months from diagnosis to transplant. Required ONLY outside first complete remission. More than 12 scores 1.
Donor type [hla-identical-sibling = 0; unrelated = 1]. THESE ARE THE ONLY TWO PUBLISHED CATEGORIES - haploidentical and cord-blood donors have no defined value in this score.
Female donor into a male recipient. ONE DIRECTION ONLY: this exact combination scores 1; male donor into female recipient and both matched combinations score 0.
